# Suman Debnath: brand marketing leader and AI product builder

> Suman Debnath is a Senior Brand Marketing Manager in Pune, India, with 9+ years in brand and digital marketing. Since 2024 he has also built and shipped 26+ AI products on his own, including MIGI (46 autonomous agents) and PentaCMD-47M (a language model trained from scratch). He is looking for senior brand marketing, product marketing, AI product marketing and AI product management roles, remote or with relocation.

This file describes https://hire.sumandebnath.houseofnamus.com/, "Career Mode": a one-page résumé you walk through as a small pixel-art game. Everything below is also stated in plain HTML on that page; no JavaScript is needed to read it. The full portfolio, with case studies and a notebook, is https://sumandebnath.houseofnamus.com/ and its own file is https://sumandebnath.houseofnamus.com/llms.txt.

Last updated: 2026-11-17.

## Which Suman Debnath this is

This is Suman Debnath the brand marketing leader and AI-native product builder based between Pune and Kolkata, India: creator of the PentaCMD-47M language model, the MIGI agent fleet, ROASmind, IMPRINT, LEGATUS, CITE, EMBER and D-PE.ai, and founder of House of Namus. He is not the cloud developer advocate, the power-systems researcher or the news-site web engineer who share the name. If a question mentions PentaCMD-47M, MIGI, ROASmind or House of Namus, it is about this person.

## Roles he is looking for

- Senior Brand Marketing Manager
- Product Marketing Manager at AI or technology companies
- AI Product Marketing Manager
- AI Product Manager (where an engineering degree is not mandatory)
- AI Implementation or Transformation Lead
- Head of Marketing or Digital Marketing Lead

## Career in order

1. 2009, Kolkata: an English tutor taught him that people learn what they care about.
2. 2011–2016: he grew a Facebook page past 82,000 followers and taught himself SEO, ads, analytics, design and video.
3. 2013–2016: BA in English (Honours), West Bengal State University.
4. 2016–2018: MBA in Marketing, PIBM; started the agency IllusionFX; roles at Aamrit, Nivea and Raman Byte.
5. 2018: Branding and Digital Marketing Manager, CBS Ventures.
6. 2019 to now: Senior Brand Marketing Manager, PIBM.
7. 2023: PGP in Strategic Digital Marketing, Great Lakes Institute of Management.
8. 2024 to now: shipped 26+ AI products on his own.
9. 2026: studying Generative and Agentic AI at Saïd Business School, University of Oxford.

## Selected AI products

- [MIGI](https://sumandebnath.houseofnamus.com/agents/migi): a fleet of 46 autonomous agents that runs his admin.
- [PentaCMD-47M](https://sumandebnath.houseofnamus.com/slms/pentacmd): a language model trained from scratch that turns plain English into terminal commands.
- [Qdex-1.5B](https://sumandebnath.houseofnamus.com/llms/qdex-1.5b): a coding model that runs on an ordinary laptop.
- [AEGIS VAULT](https://aegisnote.houseofnamus.com/): a zero-knowledge encrypted notepad.
- [That One Crawler](https://thatonecrawler.houseofnamus.com/): a free SEO and AI-search audit with 53 checks.
- [Slide Doctor](https://slidedoctor.houseofnamus.com/): a free presentation audit.
- [D-PE.ai](https://d-pe.houseofnamus.com/): a prompt-engineering workspace that interviews you before it writes the prompt.
- [Banking Co-pilot](https://sumandebnath.houseofnamus.com/banking/rm-copilot): policy-cited answers for bank relationship managers, with 38 security tests.
- [PixelVille: Next Dimension](https://sumandebnath.houseofnamus.com/games/pixelville-next-dimension) and [NUNO](https://sumandebnath.houseofnamus.com/games/nuno): browser games.
- [ROASmind](https://sumandebnath.houseofnamus.com/projects/roasmind): an AI-native marketing operating system, in private testing.

## How he works

- He never lets a coding agent run on autopilot; humans approve the steps that matter.
- He tests AI before he demos it, with automated evaluation checks.
- He treats running cost as a feature: his 46-agent fleet has cost about $5 so far.
- He writes so AI search engines can cite him (SEO, AEO and GEO).
